product.name: Monoprice Heavy Duty Power Cord - NEMA 6-20P to IEC 60320 C13 14AWG 15A/3750W SJT 250V Black 3ft
product.description: Connect your computer, monitor, power adapter, or other device with a male IEC 60320 C14 panel connector to a UPS or other AC power source. This power cord features a standard, grounded NEMA® 6‑20P plug on one end and an IEC 60320 C13 connector on the other end. Simply mate the female C13 connector with the male C14 connector on your device or power adapter, then plug the NEMA connector into a nearby AC power outlet, UPS, or other AC power source. This cable is designed to carry a 15 amp/3750 watt, 250 volt load.
